reference_reproduction.note: the pinned 7f28259 engine executed here versus its own historical cells; a loss here is a host / timing / reproduction issue of the reference, not evidence against the new wrapper

historical_experimental_preservation.note: the recovered scored 3283cfd cells (reference/HISTORICAL_3283CFD_122_CELLS.json; source ANALYSIS.json sha256 45d954bb...), every cell bound to the current inputs by model / evidence hash; gains are reported, not forbidden; historical timings are not same-host latency evidence

paired_overhead.criterion: a task is FLAGGED when PGM_ACCEPTED is slower than PGM_REFERENCE in BOTH repeats by more than 1.25x AND more than 0.1 s (paired, same-round mutual completions)
paired_overhead.effect: a flag holds default promotion pending a recorded explanation; all paired wall ratios and differences are reported

validity_with_adjudicated_incidents_set_.note: the same validity predicate with ONLY the exactly listed adjudicated incidents (INCIDENTS.json: job, kind, evidence, disposition) set aside; any other identity failure keeps this FAIL; the frozen `validity` gate above keeps every failure

promotion_decision.rule: accepted becomes the shipped default on main only with validity PASS, completeness PASS, historical_accepted_preservation PASS, same_round_accepted_preservation PASS and no unexplained cost flag; no re-tuning to meet any gate
